content: macOS landscape: Caramba Switcher (by Punto's original author Moskalyov) uses single Shift press=switch layout, double Shift=fix last word, exclusion lists for games/programming apps, EN+RU only, subscription. Rekey: auto-correct <200ms, excludes terminals and code editors, respects password fields, 34 languages, on-device. autokbisw: remembers last-used input source per app/window. Keyboard Pilot/SwitchKey: fixed per-app default layout. Mahou (Windows OSS): ScrollLock=convert selection, Pause=last word, Shift+Pause=last line, CapsLock=switch. SimpleSwitcher: flexible hotkeys incl double-clicks and release triggers; OS cycle hotkey for 2-3 layouts, dedicated hotkey per language for 3+. langSwitcher: selects to line start, converts whole phrase. RuSwitcher: Option tap retypes last word without clipboard round-trip.
